items.reason: A gentle cleanser keeps oily-feeling skin fresh without stripping it.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports the skin's moisture barrier, and your moisture score has some room to improve.
A daily mineral SPF 50 is the most useful long-term habit for keeping skin looking youthful.

response.routine_note: Cleanse and moisturize morning and night, then apply sunscreen every morning and reapply if you're outside for long. I left out vitamin C and the firming cream because your scan shows no need for them at 15, and simple habits will do more for how your skin looks over the years.
